text: しあわせそうに　みえるわ　グリーンにも　みならって　ほしい　くらいね

structure.jp: しあわせそうに　みえるわ
グリーンにも　みならって　ほしい　くらいね
structure.en: so much that I'd like Green to follow your example too

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.span: みならって　ほしい
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus ほしい means you want someone else to do it; that person gets に. グリーンにも　みならって　ほしい = 'I want Green to follow your example too'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: そう on a describing word says how something looks; with に　みえる it means 'appears to be'. しあわせそうに　みえる = 'it looks happy'.

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.span: みならって　ほしい　くらい
patterns.explanation: くらい after a phrase says 'so much that...', giving a measure of how strong something is. みならって　ほしい　くらい = 'so much that I'd like him to copy you'.
